$comment: The source of sf-input-country's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/country-code (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs from simai/ui-source@5100227 src/smart/country-code/smart.manifest.json); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Its x-todo are decided in x-decisions.

size.summary: The field ladder step, as sf-input's (1/3, 1/2, 1, 2, 3): the frame, the flag and the number of the same size.

required.summary: Native required phone input; the country prefix alone does not satisfy the requirement.

name.summary: Native input name used by FormData and form submission.

invalid.summary: The error state: the edge and the line under the field take the error colour and the number field carries aria-invalid.

error-message.summary: The error shown under the field in place of the hint while the field is invalid.

locale.summary: Language of the country names and the field's own words: ru or en. When not set it follows the page: Russian on a Russian page, English otherwise.

use-country-masks.summary: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (change journal attribute-input-country-presence-booleans): on by default, so it was switched off by the string "false", which is not an HTML boolean. Write fixed-mask instead; use-country-masks="false" keeps working until the date.

fixed-mask.summary: With use-mask, one mask for every country -- mask-pattern -- instead of each country's own. The presence form of use-country-masks="false".

show-code.summary: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (change journal attribute-input-country-presence-booleans): on by default, so it was switched off by the string "false", which is not an HTML boolean. Write hide-code instead; show-code="false" keeps working until the date.

hide-code.summary: The dial code is not written before the number. The presence form of show-code="false".

multi-country.summary: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (change journal attribute-input-country-presence-booleans): on by default, so it was switched off by the string "false", which is not an HTML boolean. Write fixed-country instead; multi-country="false" keeps working until the date.

fixed-country.summary: Only the country iso2 or dial-code names: the flag and the code are a picture, not a list. The presence form of multi-country="false".

lazy-flags.summary: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (change journal attribute-input-country-presence-booleans): on by default, so it was switched off by the string "false", which is not an HTML boolean. Write eager-flags instead; lazy-flags="false" keeps working until the date.

eager-flags.summary: Every flag of the list is fetched when the list is built, not as its row comes into view. The presence form of lazy-flags="false".

preferred.summary: Optional. Countries on top of the list under «Frequently chosen», as ISO codes: RU,KZ,BY. Up to two of the person's last choices come first, six rows at most. Without the attribute there is no group and no locale default; an empty value shows the recent choices alone.

change.summary: The phone value or country was committed; the native event bubbles from the inner input, which is its target. It carries no detail. The name to bind.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §16.20). Event rows send the new name first, then the old one, with one detail; setting rows map the old attribute and property to the new; host-attribute rows (no "to") stay host attributes read by the browser or the base and are listed, refused by the shim on purpose; documentary rows ("shim": "none") record a rename the shim cannot serve.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
stays a host attribute: the browser associates a form-associated element with the form it names; no shim

rows.section: rename plan R0 (ui-control RENAME-PLAN-2026-11-03), naming decision 2026-11-02
rows.note: the element is sf-input-country; sf-country-code is a subclass defined beside it until the date
the string form switches the default-on multi-country off; the element reads it itself until the date (no shim: the value is inverted, not renamed)
the string form switches the default-on use-country-masks off; the element reads it itself until the date (no shim: the value is inverted, not renamed)
the string form switches the default-on show-code off; the element reads it itself until the date (no shim: the value is inverted, not renamed)
the string form switches the default-on lazy-flags off; the element reads it itself until the date (no shim: the value is inverted, not renamed)

x-summary: A telephone field with a country picker: a button opens a searchable listbox of countries, and the chosen country sets the dial code, flag and, optionally, the input mask of the native tel input.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
lang runtime also holds the words of COUNTRY_CODE_TEXT (ui-source/src/component/country-code/js/_country_code.js): a shared script this component draws with (§11: no word lives only inside a bundle)
settings.placeholder: its default words move to lang/en.json runtime.placeholder (§11, §16 item 44)
settings.form: a host attribute the browser reads for a form-associated element (§17.1); the host joins the form it names, the inner tel input no longer does
x-decisions: lang-ru: runtime.placeholder is empty in both languages: a field without a placeholder of its own hints the chosen country's dial code (+994), the class script writes it (C87, DEV P4); value-missing says «Введите номер телефона.» as the class script did
a11y-role: textbox -- the native tel input carries the role and the name; the country toggle is a button with a listbox popup inside it (keyboard.panel)
key-effects: host Enter/Space/ArrowDown/ArrowUp open the list, Escape closes it; in the list (panel) arrows, Home and End move focus, Enter and Space select, Escape closes

template: the default template stays the Lit module js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; template.html follows when the build compiles HTML templates (one source of markup, not two)
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json

css-variables: five public variables read by the class sheet src/component/country-code/scss with the role token as fallback (§6); a state the public-variables probe cannot draw at rest (hover, an outline) takes no variable of its own yet
version: 1.1.0 -- the setting form leaves for the host attribute behind a dated alias row; a minor while the alias holds (§4.10)

form: the host is the form control through ElementInternals (§17.1); it submits the number in E.164 (§17.1 item 2, the form format: +79031234567 for the +7 903 123-45-67 it shows; the code alone submits empty) -- 1.5.0, the tel text as typed before -- and required asks for digits after the dial code
host-states: none -- the open list and the disabled look are classes the class script writes on its own root (shared with the class component); moving them to host states is left for the class script

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0: the tag is sf-input-country (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.input-country and the bundle cl-input-country follow it. sf-country-code stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-input-country, sf-country-code) (change journal tag-sf-country-code-to-sf-input-country, path-smart-country-code-to-input-country).

version 1.2.1: a stored number names its country (simai/ui-source#34 item 1). With neither iso2 nor dial-code set, the country is the one whose dial code the value starts with -- the longest that matches; where countries share a code, the one it usually means (+7 Russia, or Kazakhstan for +7 6xx and 7xx; +1 the United States; +44 the United Kingdom). A field given '+7 900 123-45-67' used to take the first country of the list, Australia (+61), and read the number through its mask as '+79 0 0123 4567'. iso2 and dial-code still win; an empty or local value still starts on the first country (component.country-code).

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-11): four settings that were on by default and switched off by the string "false" (multi-country, use-country-masks, show-code, lazy-flags) have presence forms, HTML booleans as every other field's: fixed-country, fixed-mask, hide-code, eager-flags (docs pre-check 2026-11-10 CC-05, dispatcher decision b). The string forms keep working until 2027-01-01 and are noted in SF.deprecations (change journal attribute-input-country-presence-booleans). The open list shows at most eight rows from its first paint and its flags load in a sandboxed frame and in a list drawn open: the template writes each flag's address with the row as a lazy image (component.country-code, CC-01, CC-02). The list's height is its own eight rows, never the room left in the viewport: a documentation frame that grows with its document is that room, and the list and the frame followed each other (CC-01, DEV acceptance 2026-11-11; component.country-code 1.3.3). The label is the field label of sf-input already (FB-10).

version 1.5.0 (2026-11-12, C87 leftovers): the form value is the number in E.164 (+79031234567), not the text as typed; the locked code of fixed-country and use-mask fields is reached by no edit (a digit typed before it goes after it, select-all keeps it); a search that finds nothing says «Ничего не найдено» / «Nothing found» (word nothing-found, .sf-country-code-empty)

version 1.5.0, same unreleased version (2026-11-12, owner q-8794872748): preferred is an optional setting -- without the attribute (class data-preferred) the list has no «Frequently chosen» group at all, recent choices included; the locale default list (a Russian page: RU, KZ, BY, UZ, KG, AM) is removed; an empty value shows the recent choices alone

version 1.6.0 (2026-11-14, fields ladder; R222 groundwork): a minor. The field has the error line of sf-input: new settings invalid and error-message (the error line in place of the hint, the error border, aria-invalid and aria-errormessage; component/field-contract.js); the hint line is the field's described message. size takes the field ladder's five steps, 1/3, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, as sf-input: at 1/3 and 3 the field is 28 / 56 high at 1440 (24 / 48 compact, 24 / 52 on a phone); it drew both at size 1 (40). 1/2, 1 and 2 unchanged apart from the new line; values, events and keys unchanged.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input-country when the interface needs the country code behavior.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

accessibility.focus: Country-code button opens a single-select listbox. Arrows, Home, End and typeahead move focus without changing the phone; Enter/Space commit and Escape cancels. Closing by confirmation or Escape returns focus to the button; Tab leaves without trapping focus. Disabled fields do not open.

setState.summary: Applies disabled, open (or active), value, iso2 and dialCode to the rendered field; setting value dispatches native input and change from the inner input. Returns true when applied, false before render.

aria-label.description: Accessible name for a telephone field rendered without a visible label.
